tags: Defence Against The Dark Arts Professor James Potter
History of Magic Professor Lily Evans Potter
items.description:
"how terrible is it to love something that death can touch. oh, but how beautiful it is to know that death is dying to touch what you love."

---

"Tell me the truth, Potter!" Umbridge screeched, "Tell me where Albus Dumbledore is!"

Harry’s head lolled forward as the curse lifted for a moment, his chest heaving as he struggled to breathe.

"Go… to… hell," he rasped, defiance burning in his emerald gaze.

Her face twisted in rage, and she raised her wand again.

"CRUCIO! "

The curse slammed into him again.

---

Harry Potter dies. Harry Potter finds himself in the afterlife. Harry Potter finds himself facing Death in the face.

Death has his face.

Death tells Harry he wasn't meant to die, and gives Harry three propositions: go back to life, wait in limbo until battle or go back to the 1940s, and complete the impossible, with the help of his mother and father.

Death tells Harry everyone dies, but not everyone lives.

And Harry...

Harry finds himself with a mission.

Harry will make sure Tom Riddle gets to live his life, for once.

items.description:
Latin; a dead language with no practical applications except perhaps the deciphering of old texts and as a particularly quaint party trick. 

Thankfully, as Harry finds out, Latin is not as dead as he was first taught when he decided to learn the language. It wouldn't have mattered anyway, of course; he loved Latin, and would have been proud to know it even had it been as useless as it was pretty.  But in the world of Wizards, the world of Magic, Harry realizes his rare talent with words is particularly valuable, and allows him to use magic that no one's ever heard of, that no one's ever seen. But as time goes on, and he becomes more and more entangled in the webs spun by those around him, he starts to realize just how deep the magical rabbit hole goes and how dangerous power like his can be. 

All Harry had ever wanted was for the world to make sense.

items.title: Counting Bodies Like Sheep
items.author: rightonthelimit
items.description:
It's a crazy world torn straight out of a horror movie - the undead roam the earth and destroy everything in their wake. When Harry Potter narrowly escapes a horrible death he finds himself a companion in Tom Riddle - a mysterious, heartless man who doesn't hesitate to take lives to save his own. Savage as the man is, Harry still finds himself enthralled... He quickly starts developing strange needs and feelings.

When they decide to finally find a safe place to settle down for a while they encounter dangerous enemies on their path. Tom's past demons come back around to haunt the both of them and it becomes very clear that even after the years they spent together, Harry really doesn't know Tom at all.

items.title: I've crossed oceans of time to find you
items.author: Lamila
tags: Canon Divergence - Post-Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
items.description:
Molly Weasley always said the twins experiments would hurt someone. Perpaps noone died, but Harry was hurled back in time and spent about a year in the 1940s before being returned to the right time. Now, the present start to remember their new past, and have to come to terms with how time changes everything, and everyone.

EDIT 10th august 2025:
On hiatus due to newborn.
Not abandoned

items.title: How Fate Intended

items.description:
The tattered memory of Tom Riddle sat on the porch of number four Privet Drive, pressing desperately into the horcrux housed in Harry Potter’s forehead.

or

In which Harry Potter is unceremoniously thrust back in time and forced to deal with Voldemort whining inside his head. At least Death had the decency to apologize.

items.title: Everything's Fine in the Beast Division
items.author: Merrinpippy
tags: Alternate Universe - Everyone's About the Same Age Now
items.description: Harry's lifelong ambition is to become an auror, but as his knowledge of Dangerous Beasts is somewhat lacking, Newt Scamander agrees to take him on as an apprentice. Contrary to the Weasley twins' predictions that Harry would die of boredom, Harry finds his time at the Ministry very interesting, and befriending the very attractive Tom Riddle doesn't hurt at all- in fact, quite the opposite.

items.title: How About No
items.author: galileagalilei
items.description:
It isn’t widely known, but when someone dies under a very specific set of conditions, something extraordinary may occur. These conditions aren’t impossible, mind you, but one could safely say that only a single individual has ever fulfilled all of them.

Put more succinctly: for a miracle such as the one you’re about to hear of to happen, you’d have to be Harry Potter.

items.title: Of Kings, of Pawns, and of Men
items.author: mads999
items.description:
When Harry succumbs to dementors in Little Whinging, the last thing he expects is to wake up and find Tom Riddle’s face staring back at him in the mirror.

It only goes downhill from there.

(In which Harry learns: if Voldemort had been like an atom bomb, Tom Riddle is the biblical forbidden fruit, succulent and fragrant and filled with an insidious rot that just may kill him.)

Ongoing Translation(s): Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese

items.title: God of Nothing

tags: Harry and Tom are both orphans
items.description:
The other orphans warn him about Tom Riddle, about the things that go missing, the way he makes people disappear. 'Stay off his radar' seems to be the advice.

Unfortunately for Harry, accidentally saving his life makes that rather difficult.

items.description:
It had been three weeks since Harry had mistakenly landed in the 1970s, given his name to Dumbledore as Harry James, and been re-Sorted as a Slytherin.

It had been two weeks since, in an effort to avoid his mother and the Marauders, Harry had started hanging out with Snape.

It had been one week since, to his absolute, gut-wrenching horror, he had been asked out by Lily Evans to Hogsmeade.

Harry had never imagined there could be anything worse than facing down Lord Voldemort in a creepy graveyard. He had been wrong.Meet Harry Potter. He's broken the timeline, busted his parents' first date, and potentially botched his chances of ever being born.

And, just maybe, he's also caught the attention of a certain rising Dark Lord.

items.description:
Jack vuole realizzare il suo sogno di diventare attore, anche se questo significa venire ripudiato dalla famiglia e dover cercare l’unico lavoro che il padre non riesca a fargli perdere: lo spogliarellista. Per pagarsi il college accetta perfino di lavorare a un singolare addio al nubilato dove dovrà “svestire” i panni di Babbo Natale. Quella notte fa una promessa a se stesso: nulla dovrà distrarlo dal suo obiettivo.
Un anno dopo scopriamo che la tenacia di Jack è stata ripagata e che lo spettacolo Lezioni di seduzione gli è valso l’ingresso nell’importante accademia di arte drammatica di Londra. Di qua dall’oceano, però, ha lasciato il cuore e le occasioni di vedere la sua Liz sono davvero poche, per questo accetta di trascorrere i giorni di festa con la famiglia di lei, ritrovandosi in situazioni a dir poco imbarazzanti alla ricerca di momenti di intimità. Allo scoccare della mezzanotte Jack fa una nuova promessa, a se stesso e a Liz: diventerà un bravo attore ma non dimenticherà di essere anche un bravo compagno per lei. Ce la farà? 
Forse Liz non rimarrà l’unica a rubargli il cuore
